title: Alice's bit on a leaf rectangle
statement: Let $p$ be a protocol over input types $X$ and $Y$, let $A\subseteq X$ and $B\subseteq Y$, let $f:X\to\{0,1\}$, and choose a bit $b$. If $R$ is among the leaf rectangles of $p$ when the first input is restricted to $A\cap\{x:f(x)=b\}$ and the second to $B$, then every $(x,y)\in R$ satisfies $f(x)=b$.
hypotheses_covered: A protocol over input types $X$ and $Y$
Membership of $R$ among the leaf rectangles under the specified input restriction
replaced:
Let $p$ be a protocol on $X \times Y$, let $A \subseteq X$, $B \subseteq Y$, let
$f : X \to \{0,1\}$ be the bit Alice sends, and let $b$ be a bit. If $R$ is a leaf
rectangle of $p$ run on the restricted input set $(A \cap \{x \mid f(x) = b\}) \times B$,
then every input $(x, y) \in R$ satisfies $f(x) = b$.
